description: BondedTradeX extends the ERC-8004 autonomous trading standard by introducing a liability layer. The system consists of a BondingVault.sol contract that holds agent collateral, a RiskCalculator service that adjusts bond requirements based on real-time volatility (using Chainlink Oracles), and an AgentController that halts trading if the bond-to-risk ratio drops below 1.0.
